messages:
alex_sales: Heads-up: FinEdge POC kicks off Mon. They require BYOK via their on-prem HSM proxy for encrypt/decrypt + signing. Main questions: firewall steps, expected rotation behavior, perf impact, and POC billing model. Adding SE/Sec/Billing.
pat_se: Quick Q: full CMK (HSM holds root) or wrapped-ephemeral pattern? Also are they doing per-request encrypts or batching? affects latency.
alex_sales: They said full CMK and per-request encrypt/decrypt (and occasional token signing). Theyplan to route to our key-proxy over a TLS tunnel.
jordana_security: Need customerQ3.4 on key custody to respond. Theyalso asked for HSM certification level and audit-log export options.
customer_tech: Sending network note: egress from 10.40.0.0/16, TLS terminated at your proxy, expected steady 300 RPS peak, pen-test scheduled one week post-POC.
mike_infra: Perf note: an external HSM proxy adds RTT. Rough estimate 25	6ms per HSM op depending on region. If every token triggers an HSM call you'd see significant tail. Recommend enabling Redwood-side prefix/KV caching and batching.
pat_se: Sample config we typically provide:

```yaml
key_proxy:
  url: https://proxy.finedge.example:8443
  client_cert: finedge-client.pem
  allowed_eips:
    - 10.40.0.0/16
  caching:
    enabled: true
    ttl_seconds: 120
```
pat_se: With that, identical prefix encrypts avoid HSM. Rotation still needs HSM ops.
kate_account: Billing: we can run POC as hosted metered usage with a pilot discount (standard 15%). If they insist on a latency SLA or steady 300 RPS, we should propose a short Dedicated quote. Agree?
alex_sales: Yes start metered + 15% pilot discount. Add clause: Dedicated if sustained >X RPS or SLA required.
jordana_security: Rotation model: we support canary rollouts. Process: create new key version, dual-write during canary window, flip, deprecate old version after retention period. Need to capture who triggers rotation and retention / audit requirements in SOW.
customer_tech: Attestation: can you provide HSM cert chain and exportable audit logs (syslog/S3)? Also what's default log retention?
mike_infra: We can provide signed attestation bundle + cert chain. Audit logs can be streamed to their S3 or delivered for 30/90/365 retention tiers; long-term retention is an add-on.
jordana_security: We'll include exportable JSON audit events for KEY_CREATE, KEY_ROTATE, KEY_ACCESS, KEY_DELETE. We can redact internal admin usernames on request.
pat_se: Blocker: external pen-test against the proxy needs preauth playbook. We'll require a test window, contact, and allowlist for their scanner IPs.
alex_sales: Action items + owners:
- pat_se: draft key-proxy configuration + SOW rotation snippet (today)
- jordana_security: fill Q3.4 + attest package (EOD)
- kate_account: POC pricing email w/ 15% pilot discount and Dedicated transition triggers (tomorrow)
- mike_infra: region-specific latency estimate + pen-test runbook
customer_tech: We'll provide egress IPs + client cert by EOD. Wealso want a mid-POC rotation dry-run in staging. Can you support?
alex_sales: Yes to mid-POC dry-run. We'll schedule a brief dry-run after certs are in place.
mike_infra: For sustained 300 RPS I'd recommend a small Dedicated pool even for the POC to avoid noisy-neighbor effects; I'll quantify instance counts in my estimate.
pat_se: I'll include fallback guidance: switch to wrapped-ephemeral key flow if HSM latency causes unacceptable tail. Also include cache TTL recommendation and how to handle cache misses.
jordana_security: I'll attach the completed security questionnaire responses here when ready.
alex_sales: Great. I'll confirm kickoff time once we have the cert + IPs. :thumbsup:
